records.explanationVi: The final clause records a provisional merger and pending scientific review, which is workflow/taxonomy state rather than learner grammar. English definition, countable/plural example and Oxford two-noun-sense evidence do not need that clause.
“4600 POS evidence” exposes provenance and the fluid label is not a usage rule. The schedule example supports an adjective describing a situation that can change.
The Master-overlap and identity-review sentence documents curation, not the adjective’s grammar. Oxford and 4600 both support exact meaning precise/correct.
“Source groups provisionally coalesced; owner may split” is an unresolved editorial boundary, not a learner-facing usage note. Happy with the painting provides a clear satisfaction construction.

Ghi chú “happy to + infinitive; willingness is not identical to emotional happiness.” nêu cách kết hợp hoặc phân bố phù hợp POS ADJECTIVE; ví dụ “I am happy to carry the lighter bag.” thể hiện cụ thể cấu trúc đó. Definition “Willing to do something, often with pleasure.” và evidence nguồn đã pin không cho thấy mâu thuẫn ngữ pháp cần sửa.

The phrase “here” evaluates the current proposal and the note incorrectly labels the example’s “not walk far” as comparative intensification. The draft example is a distance adverb, so replace the process-like, mismatched text with a usable pattern.

Đối chiếu POS ADJECTIVE, definition “At the more distant side or end of a place.” và ví dụ “A red gate stood at the far end of the field.”, hướng dẫn “Usually attributive far end/side; relative distance.” là thông tin sử dụng cụ thể. Evidence local phù hợp, nên giữ nguyên note hiệu lực.
“Source go/leave coalesced for review” is unresolved source-boundary workflow. Destination and irregular-form guidance are useful, while Oxford lists both go-to-a-place and leave uses.

Ghi chú “a go at + noun/gerund; countable; not a travel event.” nêu cách kết hợp hoặc phân bố phù hợp POS NOUN; ví dụ “May I have a go at the puzzle?” thể hiện cụ thể cấu trúc đó. Definition “An attempt to do something or a turn at an activity.” và evidence nguồn đã pin không cho thấy mâu thuẫn ngữ pháp cần sửa.

Ở ví dụ “We put the spare blankets in the hallway closet.”, cách dùng khớp hướng dẫn “Countable; especially American English; no figurative disclosure construction here.” cho POS NOUN. Ghi chú hỗ trợ người học phân biệt cấu trúc/ý nghĩa của definition “A cupboard or small enclosed space used to keep clothes or other things.”; không thấy trạng thái quy trình hoặc lỗi được xác nhận.

“Compare pinned Master meaning without asserting Sense identity” refers to an internal reference and approval boundary, not English grammar. Countability is learner-relevant, and the source permits animals or people.

Ghi chú hiện tại giải thích “deviate from something; no transitive direct object in this use.”; example “The route deviates from the river near the bridge.” minh họa chính cách dùng này trong nghĩa “To move away from a usual, planned or accepted course of action.”. Không phát hiện câu trạng thái biên tập hay sai khác có chứng cứ trong record được kiểm tra.
“VERB is schema-compatible proposal” is a data-model comment. The remaining modal rule is useful, but the current note should describe the non-inflected form directly.

Ở ví dụ “You can borrow my ruler during the test.”, cách dùng khớp hướng dẫn “Modal + bare infinitive; can permission is distinct from ability in context.” cho POS VERB. Ghi chú hỗ trợ người học phân biệt cấu trúc/ý nghĩa của definition “Used to ask for or give permission to do something.”; không thấy trạng thái quy trình hoặc lỗi được xác nhận.

Đối chiếu POS NOUN, definition “A metal container used for food, drink or other products.” và ví dụ “She opened a can of beans for lunch.”, hướng dẫn “Countable; can of + contents; British tin often corresponds.” là thông tin sử dụng cụ thể. Evidence local phù hợp, nên giữ nguyên note hiệu lực.
“History-linked runtime identity remains preserved, no mapping” describes technical mapping and history, not grammar. The draft definition and lamp example support ordinary countable noun usage.

Ghi chú “Countable; accommodation use; not the verb lodge a complaint.” nêu cách kết hợp hoặc phân bố phù hợp POS NOUN; ví dụ “The walking group spent the night at a mountain lodge.” thể hiện cụ thể cấu trúc đó. Definition “A building in the countryside or mountains where visitors stay, often for outdoor activities.” và evidence nguồn đã pin không cho thấy mâu thuẫn ngữ pháp cần sửa.
“Scalar proposal; exact boundaries pending” explicitly marks an unresolved editorial proposal. It gives no learner guidance despite the adjective’s usable physical-height example.

Đối chiếu POS ADVERB, definition “At or to a position near the ground or below the usual level.” và ví dụ “The bird flew low over the field.”, hướng dẫn “Adverb modifies flew; distinguish from adjective before a noun.” là thông tin sử dụng cụ thể. Evidence local phù hợp, nên giữ nguyên note hiệu lực.

The note distinguishes a temperature low but its phrase “not emotional diagnosis” is an editorial caveat rather than grammar. The example supports countability; a learner-facing alternative is plausible, but this checkpoint conservatively records it as possible hygiene only.

Ghi chú “Countable; human/animal limb; distinct from a furniture support.” nêu cách kết hợp hoặc phân bố phù hợp POS NOUN; ví dụ “He stretched his legs after the long journey.” thể hiện cụ thể cấu trúc đó. Definition “One of the body parts that support a person or animal and help it stand or move.” và evidence nguồn đã pin không cho thấy mâu thuẫn ngữ pháp cần sửa.
“Identity metaphor needs owner review” is an internal decision/status note. The example shows ordinary countable leg of furniture construction.

Đối chiếu POS VERB, definition “To pay attention to a sound or to what someone is saying.” và ví dụ “Please listen to the announcement before leaving.”, hướng dẫn “listen to + source; no direct object listen the announcement; hearing can occur without listening.” là thông tin sử dụng cụ thể. Evidence local phù hợp, nên giữ nguyên note hiệu lực.

Ghi chú hỗ trợ người học phân biệt cấu trúc/ý nghĩa của definition “To enter someone's details in an official record, or give your own details to join something.”; không thấy trạng thái quy trình hoặc lỗi được xác nhận.

Ghi chú “abundant resources; distinguish availability from frequent events.” nêu cách kết hợp hoặc phân bố phù hợp POS ADJECTIVE; ví dụ “Fresh fruit is abundant here during the summer.” thể hiện cụ thể cấu trúc đó. Ở ví dụ “The shelter provides support for people affected by abuse.”, cách dùng khớp hướng dẫn “Usually uncountable in this sense; use sensitive, non-graphic contexts.” cho POS NOUN. “No offensive quotation is needed for teaching” is an authoring instruction, not a grammar rule. A learner-facing note can instead show the supported verbal abuse construction without quoting insults.

Đối chiếu POS VERB, definition “To direct harsh, insulting words at someone.” và ví dụ “The driver was reported for abusing a passenger.”, hướng dẫn “Transitive; retain context to distinguish from physical harm.” là thông tin sử dụng cụ thể. Evidence local phù hợp, nên giữ nguyên note hiệu lực.

Ghi chú hiện tại giải thích “Strong negative evaluation; more emphatic than poor.”; example “The hotel received complaints about its abysmal service.” minh họa chính cách dùng này trong nghĩa “Very bad in quality, performance or condition.”. Không phát hiện câu trạng thái biên tập hay sai khác có chứng cứ trong record được kiểm tra.
“Source groups provisionally combined; owner may split” is unresolved editorial taxonomy. The note should teach adjective placement and avoid reporting a pending split.

Ở ví dụ “Several academics contributed to the public discussion.”, cách dùng khớp hướng dẫn “Countable noun; do not use this noun for every student.” cho POS NOUN. Ghi chú hỗ trợ người học phân biệt cấu trúc/ý nghĩa của definition “A person whose work involves teaching or research at a university.”; không thấy trạng thái quy trình hoặc lỗi được xác nhận.
The warning that accent is not a measure of intelligence or ability is useful anti-stereotype context, but it is not grammar. It may be intentionally pedagogical, so no replacement is proposed.

Ghi chú hiện tại giải thích “Countable; which mark is required depends on the language.”; example “The teacher explained why the French word needs an accent.” minh họa chính cách dùng này trong nghĩa “A written mark placed on a letter to indicate pronunciation or another spelling distinction.”. Đối chiếu POS ADVERB, definition “In a way that was not planned or intended.” và ví dụ “I accidentally sent the message to the wrong person.”, hướng dẫn “Modifies an action; distinguish an accident from an intentional choice.” là thông tin sử dụng cụ thể. Evidence local phù hợp, nên giữ nguyên note hiệu lực.

“Institution/building use combined; no visa or legal advice” states editorial grouping and a service disclaimer. The definition/example support the organization and its premises as countable uses.
“Exclamation source maps provisionally to INTERJECTION” is an unresolved POS mapping note, not usage. The current example is a direct farewell expression.
“Grammatical representation may coalesce with interjection” is an unresolved taxonomy decision. The noun example and plural form can be described directly.

The immigration-status caution is not grammar, though it guards against an overreading of resident. Because the definition is broad and the caution may be purposeful, retain as possible non-grammar material without a correction proposal.
“Grammatical boundary with noun pending” records an unresolved taxonomy decision. The example supports the attributive adjective resident population.

“PRONOUN is source convention, nominal analysis also needs review” reports source taxonomy and unresolved analysis. The example supports plenty of + noun, while Oxford/source use also allows plenty without a following noun.
“Source groups provisionally coalesced” is editorial boundary status, and the noble-title exclusion is not grammar for this peer sense. The example supports plural peer with a possessive relation.
